### Marks you can use while taking notes

| Mark        | Meaning            |
|-------------|--------------------|
| `[++ text]` | proposed insertion |
| `[-- text]` | proposed deletion  |
| `[!! text]` | highlight          |
| `[>> text]` | comment            |

Hover to the right of a paragraph in the preview and click the plus sign to add a comment without typing the brackets.

::: {.callout-note}
These are suggestions, not tracked changes. To accept an insertion or keep text marked for deletion, remove the brackets. To reject an insertion or accept a deletion, delete the marked text.
:::
